guarded_teacher_v2.per_Request_hidden_limit: candidate Hidden-L2 <= 1.05 times that variant per-Request Hidden-best
guarded_teacher_v2.per_Request_KL_guard: candidate Output KL <= same-Request canonical Static Output KL + 1e-6
guarded_teacher_v2.selection: minimum DeltaNLL, then KL, Hidden-L2, mask hash

controlled_search.proposal: equal mean of deterministic descending rank scores for included raw features

necessity_rules.feature_is_necessary_if_leave_one_out: Balanced-Go fails, any Request lacks a feasible mask, or mean Hidden-L2 is more than 5 percent worse than full_OHKL
necessity_rules.subset_is_sufficient_if: Balanced-Go passes, 10 of 10 Requests are feasible and correct, and mean Hidden-L2 is no more than 5 percent worse than full_OHKL
necessity_rules.minimal_subset_selection: fewest raw features among sufficient subsets, then lowest mean Hidden-L2, then variant name
